calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Events and card due dates in one place — in the calendar on your phone, and in reminders.

forbidden.title: This page isn't open to you
forbidden.body: Calendar subscriptions are personal. Check that you're signed in to your own account.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: The agenda will refresh itself once you're back online.

agenda.title: The days ahead
agenda.description: Your events and the cards whose due date is coming up.

empty.title: Nothing in the days ahead
empty.body: Create an event or give a card a due date and it will show up here.

error.title: Couldn't open your agenda
error.body: Something went wrong with the connection. Try again.

feeds.title: Calendar subscriptions
feeds.description: Connect your WorkPortal calendar to your phone or Outlook with a secret link.
feeds.secretWarning: This link is a key. Anyone who has it can read your events and due dates. Only paste it into your own app.

kind.allHelp: Both events and cards that have a due date.
kind.eventsHelp: Only the events you take part in.
kind.tasksHelp: Only cards assigned to you that have a due date.

url.webcalHelp: For iPhone, Apple Calendar and Outlook — opens the calendar app straight away.
url.caldavHelp: For DAVx5, Thunderbird and Evolution. Read-only.

rotate.confirmBody: The old link stops working immediately. You'll have to paste the new one into your calendar app again.

empty.title: No subscriptions yet
empty.body: Create one and your events will show up in the calendar on your phone.

error.title: Couldn't open your subscriptions
error.body: Something went wrong with the connection. Try again.

push.title: Browser reminders
push.description: You'll hear about it when a due date is near or someone mentions you — even with WorkPortal closed.

what.title: What you'll be told about
what.mentioned: Someone mentions you in a comment
what.assigned: A card is assigned to you
what.due: A card's due date is near
what.decision: A decision is waiting on you

quietHours.note: Nothing arrives during your quiet hours — they follow the times in your inbox settings.

unsupported.title: This browser can't do reminders
unsupported.body: Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox. On iPhone, add WorkPortal to your Home Screen first.

denied.title: Your browser has blocked notifications
denied.body: Click the lock in the address bar, allow notifications for this site, then try again.

disabledOnServer.title: Reminders aren't set up on this server
disabledOnServer.body: Browser reminders stay off until an administrator enables the VAPID keys.

error.title: Couldn't open your settings
error.body: Something went wrong with the connection. Try again.

addTo.label: Add to calendar
addTo.hint: Copies the event into your own calendar.
